primary_endpoint: Percentage change in HVPG from baseline after 8 weeks of treatment.
efficacy_outcome: In NASH groups, HVPG changed by +3.83% with avenciguat and +3.27% with avenciguat plus empagliflozin. Statistical significance was not reported.
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 6/38 patients receiving avenciguat in the NASH group and 0/25 receiving avenciguat plus empagliflozin; no deaths were reported.
